label: Euler–Bernoulli beam
text: EN.O.A1.2.1 Euler–Bernoulli beam. For a prismatic, linear-elastic member with small slopes and plane sections remaining plane and normal: EI d²v/dx² = M(x). With load q positive downward, dM/dx = V and dV/dx = −q (Gere and Goodno, §4.5; sign convention stated, audit fact check).

warrant.standard: Prediction matches test within stated uncertainty; code calibration meets the target reliability index
warrant.defeaters: Hypothesis outside range (slenderness, small strain, linearity); imperfection sensitivity; residual stress; unmodelled failure mode
